THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE  COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:10599  MFA No. 23132 of 2012  JUDGMENT
The present appeal is filed by the claimant for enhancement of compensation.
2. The factum of accident and the tractor was damaged in accident and claimant had got repaired the tractor and coverage of insurance are not disputed.

3. The Tribunal has held that the claimant at least might have spent Rs.1,25,000/- towards repair of the tractor and out of that 50% of amount is deducted towards depreciation on the ground that the tractor is 10 years old and accordingly, awarded compensation of Rs.62,500/-.
4. The claimant had produced bills for having purchase of spare parts and labour charges of tractor.
As per Ex.P8, bill is for Rs.1,78,610/- and Rs.26,000/-.
The claimant has not produced survey report, regarding what were the damage caused to the tractor and not examined the surveyor.
The claimant has straight away produced Ex.P8 NC: 2023:KHC-D:10599 regarding purchase of spare parts and labour charges and examined the garage owner for having repaired the tractor.

The Tribunal has rightly disbelieved that the said bills at Ex.P8 worth of Rs.2,04,610/- in the absence of survey report and evidence of amount stated to have been spent for repair being found to be excessive one.

Therefore, the assessment of damages made by the claimant is approximately of Rs.1,25,000/-, as held by the Tribunal is found to be just and proper and accordingly it is accepted.
5.
But, the Tribunal has committed an error in deducting 50% of Rs.1,25,000/- on the reason that the tractor is of 10 years old one.
Just because the tractor is of 10 years old that cannot be a reason to deduct 50% of the amount towards depreciation.

Even though, the tractor is 10 years old one, but,
it was the intention of the claimant that to make fit the tractor for his work and since the tractor was got damaged in the accident.
If tractor is not repaired then, the tractor is not road worthy for work.
Therefore, whatever amount has been spent by the claimant is to be awarded.
If the claimant had intended to sell the tractor, then the depreciation can be considered.
But, where the claimant wanted to make the tractor road worthy for work, then whatever actual amount spent by the claimant towards repair cost has to be awarded.

In the present case, Tribunal has assessed that the claimant might have spent Rs.1,25,000/- towards repair of tractor and that is to be accepted without deduction of 50% of amount towards depreciation.

Therefore, the claimant is Rudrappa S/O Mallappa Pagad vs Sharachandra C Pasalkar on 14 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16273639/
2 entitled for a sum of Rs.1,25,000/- as damages.
6.
